scope: authoritative reproduced final-submission results; Amsterdam values are internal development results, not organiser held-out scores
method: frozen two-tier Madrid Random Forest transfer

score_product.source_prior_adjustment: multiply RF scores by uniform/source empirical class frequency and renormalise

feature_generation.gap_filling: linear interpolation, then backward fill and forward fill within pixel
feature_generation.temporal_year_convention: inclusive minimum-to-maximum year present in the supplied dataset

madrid_stage1_random_cv.protocol: 5-fold x 5-repeat stratified random CV; scaler fitted within every fold
